# Northern Woodsmen Tree Service
> Tree service services in Wilsonville, Oregon and the Portland metro. Oregon CCB #259429. (281) 413-9752.

## Services
- [Tree Removal](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/tree-removal/): full removals, hazard trees, tight-access takedowns. $450–$2,500 depending on size and access
- [Tree Trimming & Pruning](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/tree-trimming/): structural pruning, deadwooding, clearance, thinning. $300–$1,200
- [Stump Grinding](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/stump-grinding/): grinding below grade, root chasing, backfill. $120–$450 per stump
- [Storm & Emergency Tree Service](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/emergency-tree-service/): failed trees, limbs on structures, blocked access. Quoted on site; emergency response
- [Lot Clearing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/lot-clearing/): clearing for building, pasture, or defensible space. $1,500–$8,000 per acre
- [Hazard Tree Assessment](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/hazard-tree-assessment/): risk evaluation, defect identification, written findings. $150–$400
- [Cabling & Bracing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/cabling-bracing/): support systems for split trunks and heavy limbs. $350–$1,200
- [Brush Chipping & Haul-Off](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/brush-chipping/): chipping, debris removal, chip drop. $200–$700
- [Tree Planting](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/tree-planting/): species selection, siting, staking, establishment. $150–$600 per tree installed
- [Crown Reduction](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/crown-reduction/): lowering height and spread without topping. $400–$1,500
- [Root Pruning](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/root-pruning/): clearance for foundations, sidewalks, and utilities. $300–$900
- [Arborist Consultation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/arborist-consultation/): health diagnosis, preservation plans, development reports. $150–$500
- [Defensible Space & Fire Clearance](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/defensible-space/): ladder fuel removal, limbing up, clearance zones. $800–$4,000
- [Tree Lighting Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/northern-woodsmen-tree-service-llc/services/holiday-lighting/): seasonal lighting in mature trees, install and removal. $400–$2,000
